newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta posts C$1.132 bln surplus in fiscal 95-96.
newsitem.headline: Alberta posts C$1.132 bln surplus in fiscal 95-96.

text.p: The Conservative government of the Canadian province of Alberta said on Wednesday that it recorded a C$1.132 billion budget surplus in the 1995-96 fiscal year ended March 31.
The 1995-96 surplus was up sharply from budget forecasts, due mostly to higher-than-predicted income tax revenues, the government said.
The government had a C$672 million surplus in fiscal 1994-95. Earlier this year, Finance Minister Jim Dinning forecast a budget surplus of between C$325 million and C$869 million for fiscal 1996-97.
